title: "F-coin — Coin tossing"
status: "Canonical"
layer: 6
---

*F-coin* (Coin tossing) is part of *Secret Sharing, Threshold Cryptography, MPC* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: a canonical, well-established UC functionality.

With guaranteed output delivery, coin tossing is unrealizable for two parties — the abort variant is the one actually realized.

*References:*

- Damgård and Lunemann. [*Quantum-secure coin-flipping and applications*](https://www.iacr.org/archive/asiacrypt2009/59120050/59120050.pdf). In Advances in Cryptology – ASIACRYPT 2009, 2009.
- Blum. [*Coin flipping by telephone*](https://www.cs.cmu.edu/~mblum/research/pdf/coin/). In IEEE Spring COMPCON, pages 133–137, 1982.
